purpose.summary: This program (ORCSC93) is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software. It performs medical procedure (shinryo koui) item splitting, editing, and validation — specifically separating and classifying medical procedure items by category, checking examination counts, and validating set codes and hospitalization flags.
